segment.description: Fletchers Fork — a stream on the Fort Campbell military reservation in Montgomery County, Tennessee (catalog; HUC 05130206), stocked with trout under the post's program governed by CAM Regulation 200-4. This is a put-and-take military-post fishery, not a TWRA wild-trout or year-round water: Fort Campbell's official iSportsman page shows 2026 trout stockings running February through August, supplied by KDFWR (Feb/Apr) and TWRA (Jun-Aug).
segment.boundaries: The stocked reach(s) of Fletchers Fork within the Fort Campbell reservation, Montgomery County (catalog GNIS 01284476); the post straddles the Tennessee-Kentucky line, and stocking events are listed post-wide under 'Fort Campbell Streams'.

coldSource.notes: No cold-source documentation found; no gage or temperature record located for the creek.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. The program is put-and-take with recurring stockings roughly monthly February-August 2026 (workbook weekly-of dates 2/15, 4/19, 5/17, 6/21, 7/12, 8/23; iSportsman lists KDFWR events 2/12/2026 [1,200 rainbow total] and 4/7/2026, and TWRA events 6/25, 7/22, 8/26/2026 at ~1,000-1,024 rainbow each), and no source documents survival between stockings. Note the catalog's programmatic seasonMonths (12,1,2) conflicts with the documented 2026 pattern (no December/January rows; documented stocking months are February-August).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found; the fishery is a stocked put-and-take program on a military reservation (CAM Regulation 200-4 governs; state fishing license required in addition to post requirements).

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Put-and-take post fishery restocked with rainbow and brown trout about monthly February through August 2026 (Fletchers Fork specifically received '750 Brown Trout & 240 Rainbow Trout' in April 2026), with no evidence of survival between stockings or outside the stocked season.
